vinterestNative._about: Applied to the generated native projects by scripts/native.mjs after every sync (they are never edited by hand).

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vinterest uses the camera to read wine labels and wine lists, so it can tell you about a bottle and whether it's for you.

ios._ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption: false: the app only uses the phone's standard HTTPS, so App Store Connect doesn't ask about encryption on every upload.
